read.thesis: Costco Q2 net sales +9.1% to $68.24B with core-on-core margin +22bp and capex steady at ~$6.5B; no supply-side expansion surprise, but membership growth slowed to 4.8% and renewal dipped to 92.1%.

capex.peers_comment: Management noted competitors are opening warehouses but said it does not see a meaningful membership impact.
capex.quote: We estimate CapEx for the full year will be approximately $6,500,000,000
